title: ZEUS Support FAQ
content:
ZEUS Support FAQ · Page 1
Section 1: Opening a support case
Q: How do I open a case? A: Use the HELIOS console or call the support number on your order form. Q: When is a Severity 1 case acknowledged? A: Within 30 minutes. Q: What should I include? A: The workspace ID, UTC time of the issue, and one short description. The support terms are summarized in zeus-helios-service-guide, Section 1.

ZEUS Support FAQ · Page 2
Section 2: Case updates
Q: Can I change a case severity? A: Yes. Add the new impact and affected workspace to the case; the support analyst confirms the classification. Q: How often are active Severity 1 cases updated? A: Every 30 minutes while response work is active. Q: What happens when ZEUS needs more information? A: The support clock pauses until the requested details arrive. Do not include passwords or access tokens in a case.
